scope: Scientific adequacy of illustrative candidate answers, distinct from generic numerical integrity checks; alternative valid analyses need not match this estimator or these point estimates.

evidence: 66 raw reconstructions externally anchored to released author outputs
Per-material isolation of relative alignment and multiplicity effects
Three Gaussian resolution levels with all per-material shape/peak effects retained
Q1.answer: Relative shifts matter: at0.5eV median normalized-shape error12.8%, max41.5% material066; at1eV median5.8%, max25.6%. Unequal-population exceptions remain despite zero median weight effect.
limitations: No pairwise material-similarity ranking preservation analysis; prompt was narrowed accordingly.
No significance threshold makes a5% shape discrepancy scientifically detectable without experimental noise/targets.
Gaussian broadening is a controlled resolution probe, not an exact lifetime/instrument model.

evidence: All2681 sites linked to raw geometry and spectral inputs
Material-weighted pooled and within-material regressions controlling P coordination
Three Li cutoffs and three spectral-shift definitions
Material-block bootstrap intervals and explicit observational interpretation
Q2.answer: All18 partial slopes are positive. Nominal within-material onset/peak intervals include zero; positive centroid association persists across cutoffs, so no general red-shift rule is supported by this operational analysis.
limitations: Coordination enters as global linear predictors; nonlinear relationships, interactions and motif-specific effects are not comprehensively tested.
Finite near-edge window and peak/centroid definitions can differ from a physical absorption threshold.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on the archived material collection and200 replicates, not population-representative or causal evidence.

evidence: All48 glass structures tested by material-group exclusion
Only normalized spectral intensities are predictors
Crystal, grouped-glass and hybrid training at two resolutions
Majority control, class recall, confusion matrices and material-bootstrap uncertainty
Q3.answer: At0.5eV balanced accuracy is.679 crystal,.871 glass,.896 hybrid; crystal P2 recall31.1% versus71.1% glass.1eV retains ranking with crystal P2 recall33.3%. Majority ordinary accuracy97.0% conceals chance balanced accuracy.
limitations: Minority labels span only7 P0 and15 P2 glass structures.
Related ancestry and composition may cross folds; this tests new archived structures, not new chemistries.
Different training libraries differ in size/coverage, so score gains are not isolated effects of disorder.
Bootstrap intervals hold fitted predictions fixed; model-fitting uncertainty and paired-resolution score-difference significance are not established.

figures: Q1 effects.png, Q2 associations.png and Q3 transfer.png visually inspected; readable and consistent with tabulated results.
